title: For literal strings, prefer col_set_str() to col_add_fstr()
description:
This avoids:
- scanning for format specifiers that don't exist
- making a redundant copy of the string literal

Found using crude check:

grep col_add_fstr *.c | grep "\"" | grep -v "%"

so probably missing some cases split between lines.
